0:
ui:
  hide-url: true
  hide-hostname: true
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
interval: 5m

mkdir -p /data/serverfiles/insurgency/cfg && cp /insserver.cfg /data/serverfiles/insurgency/cfg/insserver.cfg && cp /motd.txt /data/serverfiles/insurgency/motd.txt && chown -R 1000:1000 /data && echo "Setup complete"

[rack-ups]
  driver = "usbhid-ups"
  port = "auto"
  vendorid = "10AF"
  productid = "0001"
  product = "LiebertPSI"
  serial = ""
  vendor = "Emerson Network Power"
  bus = "002"

[upsmon]
  password  = "${SECRET_NUT_PASSWORD}"
  actions = SET
  instcmds = ALL
  upsmon primary

MONITOR rack-ups@localhost:3493 1 upsmon "${SECRET_NUT_PASSWORD}" primary
POLLFREQ 15
POLLFREQALERT 5
HOSTSYNC 15

/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.title: external-dns helm release
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.name: external-dns
/hr/registry-1.docker.io-bitnamicharts-e.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

0:
version: v2
# In-cluster ClusterIP publicAddr of the proxy. tbot only joins and renews
# SVIDs (no reverse tunnel), so it honors the dialed address and reaches the
# proxy directly — bypassing the internal gateway. The proxy lists this name
# in publicAddr and serves a matching internal keypair, so TLS/SNI validate.
proxy_server: teleport-cluster.security.svc.cluster.local:443
onboarding:
  token: tape-archiver-control-worker
  join_method: kubernetes
storage:
  type: memory
services:
  - type: workload-identity-jwt
    selector:
      name: tape-archiver-control-worker
    audiences:
      - temporal.${SECRET_PUBLIC_DOMAIN_NAME}
    destination:
      type: directory
      path: /var/run/teleport/jwt
